text:
ryan: heads-up — deploy-bot just paused the canary promotion for build 2026.03.18-rc3 due to artifact verification errors on eu-west storage. unsure if it's X509 or checksum mismatch. canary is stuck.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: artifact verification failed for image redwood/inference:2026.03.18-rc3. Error: checksum_mismatch (blob 0a9f...). Manual intervention required.

jen: saw same. staging smoke tests passed earlier but integration e2e started failing after pull. logs show `BlobIntegrity: expected sha256:... got sha256:...`.

alice: is this the same cross-region replication TTL/partial upload we hit last month?

mike: probably similar but different signature. CI logs show multipart upload completed but verify step failed. suspiciously the manifest size and digest agree locally. attaching tail of runner log: 

```
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] upload completed to eu-west: /artifacts/2026/03/18/rc3/ layer-3
[2026-03-18T14:02:12Z] verify: expected sha256=0a9f... got=0b2c... (retrying)
[2026-03-18T14:02:14Z] verify: retry failed
[2026-03-18T14:02:14Z] promotion: aborting canary promotion
```

ci-bot: note: parallel uploads to region eu-west reported elevated 502s 02:00-02:15 UTC. 35/120 uploads retried.

ryan: given canary is blocked and change window ends in 2 hours, options: 1) pin production to previous digest (2026.03.17-b6) and resume other rollouts, 2) manual reupload of artifact to eu-west and re-run verify + promote (risky on time), 3) abort promotion and rollback any partials. thoughts?

jen: +1 to pin and resume. we should avoid risky manual reupload during change window. pinning is reversible and we can schedule infra follow-up.

alice: agree. also add a release-note line about transient artifact verification hiccup and that we rolled forward to older digest to meet SLO.

mike: if we pin, we should create a short postmortem ticket and assign eng-infra to check multipart upload retry logic and our artifact gateway checksums. i'll own the ticket.

ryan: ok calling it — pin to `redwood/inference@sha256:prevdigest20260317b6`. mike, please open ticket and tag eng-infra + oncall. jen, can you trigger a manual promote for remaining regions excluding eu-west once pin is in place?

jen: will do. will also add a changelog entry and note in release-notes draft: "Promotion paused for rc3 due to artifact verify failure; temporarily serving previous image to preserve latency SLOs."

deploy-bot: Manual promote request received for tag `redwood/inference@sha256:prevdigest20260317b6` — awaiting operator confirmation.

mike: ticket created: INFRA-4321 "artifact verify mismatch eu-west (rc3)" — assigned to @eng-infra, priority P1 for root cause, P2 for long-term fix. link: https://phab.internal/INFRA-4321

alice: FYI change window ops: ops-approved to proceed with pin and resume promotion in safe mode. please record final decision in release notes. :white_check_mark:

ryan: thanks all. jen please confirm when remaining regions have been promoted. leaving canary blocked on eu-west until eng-infra investigates.

jen: promoted us-east, ap-south, and ap-northeast to pinned digest. monitoring looks stable. will post update in release-notes channel once artifacts verified for those regions.

ci-bot: status: 3 regions promoted to pinned digest; eu-west remains paused.

ryan: closing this thread for now. follow-ups in INFRA-4321 and release-notes. good job everyone :thumbsup:
